lines.en: Did you know that iCarly had over 20 celebrity guest stars?
Carly and the crew got to hang out with some incredible artists
like the Plain White Teas, David Archuleta, and even One Direction.
Could I have some more fruits?
And could you cut them into the little cubes the way that you do?
Of course. I'll be right back with it.
And could you put warm socks on my feet?
Sure. I'll heat up a pair in the dryer.
Uh, what else do you want Carly to do for you? Wash your tour bus?
Celebs like Austin Butler, Jimmy Fallon, and Emma Stone also appeared on set.
Oh my God, it's iCarly. It's iCarly! Hi! Hi! Hi!
I love you! Hi, I'm lucky I'm your youngest hand in the world.
And they even filmed an episode with First Lady Michelle Obama.
Now, that's what we call a star-studded cast.
